Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur [2025:RJ-JD:47353]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc. Interim Bail Application No. 13260/2025 Ganpat Singh S/o Kalu Singh, Aged About 28 Years, Resident Of Masaba Ka Kheda Police Station Badi Sadri District Chittorgarh (Accused Presently Lodged In Dist. Jail Tonk)
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through PP 2.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Tama Bai W/o Shambhu Singh, R/o Kalyanpura, P.s. Badi

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Narendra Gehlot, PP.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 04/11/2025

The present interim bail application under Section 483 of BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner on the ground that his father Kalu Singh has expired on 17.10.2025 and his presence is required for performing last rites and rituals of his father.
It is therefore, prayed that the petitioner may be released on interim bail for a period of 30 days.
Learned Public Prosecutor has not disputed the factum of petitioner's father passing away.

Looking to the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, a humanitarian approach is required to be adopted, thus, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on interim bail for a period of 15 days.

Accordingly, the interim bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Ganpat Singh S/o Kalu Singh arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.329/2022, registered at Police Station Badi Sadri, District Chittorgarh, for the offences under Section 376(2)(f) IPC
